ledger.cultivar.title: Botanical Ledger
ledger.cultivar.empty: Use the ledger on a planted trellis to record its species.
commands.cultivar.export.done: Exported %s crops (%s not yet covered by a Cultivar plant) to %s
item.cultivar.cutting.hint: Plant on an empty trellis: %s%% chance to take (Strength)
cultivar.trial.ledger: Ledger: %s species, %s crosses left to test
block.cultivar.timber_trellis.tooltip.su: A frame to _grow Cultivar crops_ on. Sits on _soil_; the soil sets humidity, acidity and nutrients.
block.cultivar.timber_trellis.tooltip.be: _Stacks_ a segment for _tall crops_ like cane and bamboo.
Between mature neighbours it _breeds_ new plants and _mutations_.
block.cultivar.timber_trellis.tooltip.ac: Turns an empty trellis into a _grafting frame_.
block.cultivar.iron_trellis.tooltip.summ: A sturdier frame: plants on it are _more tolerant_ of imperfect conditions (a Strength bonus).
block.cultivar.iron_trellis.tooltip.acti: Turns an empty trellis into a _grafting frame_.
item.cultivar.seed.tooltip.summary: A seed carrying a _genome_: Gain, Growth, Strength and Vigour. Stats stay _hidden_ until assayed.
item.cultivar.seed.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows its _stats_, and Create filters can _sort_ it by them.
item.cultivar.cutting.tooltip.summary: A _clone_ snipped from a living plant, with its _exact genome_.
item.cultivar.cutting.tooltip.condition1: When planted on an empty trellis
item.cultivar.cutting.tooltip.behaviour1: _Takes_ with a chance set by _Strength_ and starts part-grown. A failed cutting is lost.
item.cultivar.seed_meal.tooltip.summary: Milled seeds: the end of the _cull loop_.
item.cultivar.seed_meal.tooltip.behaviou: A gentle _fertilizer_: one growth stage, never triggers mutations.
item.cultivar.bell_cloche.tooltip.summar: A glass bell for a _single trellis_.
item.cultivar.bell_cloche.tooltip.behavi: Speeds _growth_ and keeps _weeds_ down for the crop beneath.
item.cultivar.transplanting_spade.toolti: Lifts a whole plant, _genome and growth intact_, to replant elsewhere.
item.cultivar.pruning_shears.tooltip.con: When used on a plant at stage 2+
item.cultivar.pruning_shears.tooltip.beh: Drops it one stage and gives a _Cutting_ (an exact clone). Mature plants also give _clip products_.
item.cultivar.seed_satchel.tooltip.summa: Holds _one species_ of seed, sorted by genome. _Picks up_ matching seeds.
item.cultivar.seed_satchel.tooltip.condi: When used on a mature plant
item.cultivar.seed_satchel.tooltip.behav: _Harvests_ it and may keep a _seed_: chance rises with _Vigour_.
Plants the _best seed_ for the dial's stat and can _cull_ the worst into a composter.
item.cultivar.brass_dial.tooltip.summary: A Seed Satchel upgrade that _ranks_ seeds by a chosen stat.
item.cultivar.brass_dial.tooltip.behavio: The satchel plants the _best_ seed and culls the _worst_.
item.cultivar.botanical_ledger.tooltip.s: A record of every _species_ you have studied, and the _mutations_ that link them.
item.cultivar.botanical_ledger.tooltip.c: When loaded in an Assaying Engine or Trial plot
item.cultivar.botanical_ledger.tooltip.b: _Records_ the species and recipes that pass through.
block.cultivar.assaying_engine.tooltip.s: A kinetic analyser that _reveals_ a seed's stats.
block.cultivar.assaying_engine.tooltip.b: _Assays_ seeds; faster with more _RPM_. A Ledger inside _records_ each species.
block.cultivar.assaying_engine.tooltip.c: R-Click with Seeds or a Ledger
block.cultivar.sprinkler.tooltip.summary: Waters the crops around it from any _fluid pipe_.
block.cultivar.sprinkler.tooltip.behavio: Adds _growth ticks_ and the odd _bone-meal_ pulse to growables in range, and keeps _farmland_ moist. Uses 1 mB per few ticks.
block.cultivar.planter_bed.tooltip.summa: A self-contained, _pipe-fed_ growing station. Touching beds form _one plot_.
block.cultivar.planter_bed.tooltip.condi: With soil, seeds and a trellis
block.cultivar.planter_bed.tooltip.behav: _Plants, waters, fertilizes_ and _harvests_ by itself, and swaps in _better seeds_ over time.
Becomes a _breeder_: banks newborn children as seeds and re-arms the frame.
_Strips_ trellis and cloche back into stock and _dumps_ everything to pipes.
block.cultivar.planter_bed.tooltip.contr: R-Click with Soil, Trellis or Cloche
block.cultivar.trial_bed.tooltip.summary: A _research plot_. Touching trial beds _cross-test_ the seeds they are fed, with every limiter removed.
block.cultivar.trial_bed.tooltip.behavio: Grows and crosses them on its own trellises and _records_ every mutation it finds; a 9x9 also gets a timed _bonus discovery_.
_Pauses_ and lets pipes pull out its seeds.
jei.cultivar.bred_info: Found by crossbreeding two plants in the right habitat. Its cross shows here once you know it and both parents: record them in a Botanical Ledger.
jei.cultivar.assaying.ledger: Optional: a Ledger in the engine records each species it assays
jei.cultivar.info.trellis: Plant seeds on a trellis standing on soil. The soil sets humidity, acidity and nutrients (see Soils). Humidity shifts one step wetter with water beside the soil or a Bell Cloche on the trellis, and one step drier with a lit heat source (Blaze Burner, campfire, magma block) beside or under it. To cross plants, right-click an empty trellis with another trellis to make a grafting frame: mature crops beside it become its parents.
jei.cultivar.info.bell_cloche: Place it on a trellis: the crop grows 10% faster, its soil is one humidity step wetter, and no new blight takes root. Lift it off with an empty hand.
jei.cultivar.info.botanical_ledger: Your botanical knowledge belongs to you; the Ledger is how it moves. Record a planted crop with it, or let an Assaying Engine or Trial Bed fill it. Carrying or reading a Ledger teaches you what it holds and copies what you know into it. Crosses appear in JEI once you know both parents and the child.
jei.cultivar.info.planter_bed: A self-contained growing station. Touching beds form one plot that shares water, seeds and output. Feed seeds, fertilizer, trellises and Bell Cloches by pipe or hopper; it plants, grows and keeps its best seeds, and offers crops for extraction. A redstone signal strips the plot and dumps everything for collection.
jei.cultivar.info.trial_bed: A research plot. Touching trial beds grow the seeds they are fed on a checkerboard of trellises with every habitat limit removed, and record each real cross into the Ledger in their slot. Now and then they also discover an untested cross outright. A redstone signal pauses the plot and returns its seeds.
jei.cultivar.info.sprinkler: Mount it on any fluid pipe and feed it water. While it has water it gives nearby crops extra growth, sometimes a bone-meal pulse, and keeps farmland moist. A redstone signal stops it.
jei.cultivar.blight.drops: Clear it mature with a hoe for drops
